postconditions.expression: all(a_i == b_i for a_i, b_i in zip(sorted(a), sorted(b)))
postconditions.description: The multiset b can be made equal to a by performing the allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i in a for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: Each element in b can be transformed into an element in a by the allowed operations.

invariants.description: The multisets a and b have the same number of elements.

invariants.expression: all(a_i <= a_j for i < j for a_i, a_j in combinations(a, 2))
invariants.description: The elements of a are in non-decreasing order.

invariants.expression: all(b_i <= b_j for i < j for b_i, b_j in combinations(b, 2))
invariants.description: The elements of b are in non-decreasing order.
